validity.researcher_notes: Every field on this row is class=MISSING_REF with current_ref empty, so there is no existing citation trail to re-verify -- this is ground-up existence research, not ref re-verification. gem.wiki itself returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) on every fetch attempt this run (both direct WebFetch and via an r.jina.ai reader proxy), so I could not even read what, if anything, the wiki page cites; wiki_citations.json for this scope is confirmed empty for P4137. I then checked this project's own already-ingested INDEPENDENT reference datasets for Pakistan gas rather than relying on open web alone: the GulfPub (Petroleum Economist) crosswalk (94 Pakistan gas records, batches/pakistan-gas/staging/ref-sweep-operating/recon_gulfpub_crosswalk.json) has ZERO entry naming Sheikhupura+Gujranwala together, and P4137 does not appear as gem_pid in its overlaps/additions/ambiguous buckets at all (checked by exact gem_pid match and by free-text search for 'sheikhupura'/'gujranwala' across all 94 raw canonical_records.json entries -- no hit). The OSM crosswalk (9 Pakistan gas records, recon_osm_crosswalk.json) likewise has zero match. For comparison, GulfPub DOES independently corroborate many of this row's near neighbors in the same Punjab corridor under other GEM PIDs -- e.g. 'Phool Nagar - Shekhupura' (65.98 km, dia 16/24in) plausibly matches P4157/P4158 (the Dawood Hercules fertilizer plant is sited at Sheikhupura), 'Lalamusa - Lahore' and 'Daud Khel - Shakardara' both cross-match P4139 (Shahdara-Gujranwala-Rahwali) as overlaps, and 'Muzaffargarh - Chowk Permit'/'Lachi - Makori' show up as GulfPub additions/near-misses near P4139 -- so the absence of ANY GulfPub or OSM trace specifically for a direct Sheikhupura-to-Gujranwala segment is a real gap, not a generic thin-coverage artifact of this corridor. Sheikhupura (west of Lahore) and Gujranwala (northeast of Lahore) are not on an obvious single trunk together; the existing roster already covers the Lahore-to-Gujranwala axis via P4139 (Shahdara-Gujranwala-Rahwali) and the Lahore-to-Sheikhupura axis via P4157/P4158 (Phool Nagar-Dawood Hercules), which raises the possibility this row is a mis-paired or duplicated endpoint combination rather than a genuine third, independent line -- though I could not confirm a duplicate identity strongly enough to name a specific merge target. Open-web attempts to find independent confirmation were substantially blocked this session: WebSearch had already exhausted its per-session budget (200/200) before I could query it for this row; Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo/Marginalia via WebFetch all returned CAPTCHA challenges or irrelevant results; web.archive.org is unreachable to this WebFetch tool entirely; OGRA's site (ogra.org.pk) returned 403; SNGPL's own site (sngpl.com.pk) rendered only navigation shells for its Transmission Network Map / transmission-line-list pages (JS-driven, no line-level table content retrievable via WebFetch); Wikipedia's SNGPL and Gujranwala articles make no mention of this line; Dawn.com and Business Recorder searches returned nothing relevant (Business Recorder 403'd outright). I was not able to attempt Urdu-language queries given the WebSearch budget was already exhausted. Net: I have NO independent source, weak or strong, confirming this specific Sheikhupura-Gujranwala pipeline exists, against a backdrop (per this scope's own notes) of a near-certain single bulk-load source stamped 2023-07-07 across this whole batch and a demonstrated capacity of GulfPub to corroborate this exact corridor's real neighboring lines under other PIDs. That combination -- zero corroboration where corroboration should plausibly be findable -- is the existence-concern trigger, not proof of non-existence; I could not rule out that this is a real minor SNGPL feeder simply undocumented outside SNGPL's own internal records. Classification (transmission, 10in diameter, 59.44km) is internally consistent with the rest of this bulk-loaded roster (many other rows are similarly small-diameter/short-length and still tagged transmission), so I am not separately flagging classification -- if the existence question resolves against this row, classification is moot anyway. Owner (SNGPL, 100%) is plausible on priors (SNGPL is the transmission utility for essentially this entire Punjab roster) but I found no page naming this specific line's owner, so I am not staging an owner ref built on inference alone.
